summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features (markdown shortcuts, note duplication, drag & drop) plus regression on existing features. All scenarios from the review request PASSED. Cleared localStorage at test start and reloaded for a clean state.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx toggle() initial-expand logic is confusing: expanded[id] === false toggles to true, which means first click on a NOT-yet-expanded folder starts it closed (undefined -> false). However for folders the default state is rendered as open (isOpen = expanded[folder.id] !== false), so first click correctly collapses. This works but is asymmetric vs toggleNote() for sub-pages (expanded[id] !== true default closed). Consider consistent boolean handling.

moveNote() always sets parentNoteId to null when dragging onto a folder, which means drag&drop cannot preserve sub-page hierarchy. Acceptable for MVP but flag: dragging a parent note loses its sub-pages relation if they are not moved together. Currently only the dragged note's folderId/parentNoteId is reassigned; its descendants are orphaned from the folder (they stay in their original folderId). Consider cascading moves for children.
duplicateNote() does not duplicate descendant sub-pages. Duplicating a parent note gives you a shallow copy without its sub-pages. May be intentional but worth confirming product expectation.
storage.js getAll() does not try/catch JSON.parse - malformed localStorage will crash the app on load. Low risk but add safety parse.
seed_data_creation: localStorage-only test data created during the test: 'Markdown Test' note with duplicates, 'Target Folder' folder, 'Drag Me' note. Cleared between phases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features working. Markdown shortcuts tested via keyboard typing into .tiptap editor (InputRules fire). Duplicate via menu-duplicate and note-duplicate-{id}. Drag & drop tested via page.drag_and_drop(note_selector, folder_selector) which correctly simulates HTML5 drag events in tiptap/react. Verify folderId in localStorage after drop. Always page.evaluate('localStorage.clear()') then reload before a new test phase.
